verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an llms.txt file, markdown or LLM-oriented doc exports, or any documentation built for agents to consume. The Events API OpenAPI spec is a machine-readable API contract, which is adjacent rather than agent-oriented docs. The marketing line about an in-product 'Agent' describes a product feature, not docs an external agent can be pointed at.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
